description: D5 F->S2 CE + LoCa X-Token KD, depth, seed 17, from align_curve_contrastive_s17 epoch_1, confirmatory
notes: Recorded post-hoc from runs/kd/<name>/ training artifacts. The training command never passed --confirmatory, so resource_usage.json/recipe_config.json originally read pilot=true; corrected 2026-09-09 (see resource_usage.json 'corrections') because training conditions were confirmatory throughout: 4090 GPU, bf16 teacher cache, full 15278-row train split, seed 17, the standard 10-epoch/patience-2/LoRA-rank-16 policy every other confirmatory row used. For two-stage rows (D4/D5/D6/D9), predictions were generated by merging the stage-F/-P parent adapter into the base weights before applying the S2 adapter, exactly mirroring train_kd.py's own parent_checkpoint composition -- an initial attempt without the parent merge scored materially lower and was discarded before being recorded.
